transcripts.transcript:
Hello, Clara Bennett, this is Daniel Reed calling for the telephone discussion you requested. Is this still a convenient time to speak, or are you in the middle of something at the office?

Hello, Daniel. This is a good time. I've stepped away from the office, so we shouldn't be interrupted. I've recently returned from travelling and am catching up with the things I left on my desk.

Welcome back. Was that a business trip, or did you manage to get some time away from work?

Mostly business, visiting people we work with in logistics. I managed to have a quiet afternoon away from appointments, which was welcome. Travelling is useful, but the correspondence seems to accumulate while I'm away.

I hope settling back in has been straightforward. We can keep today's discussion focused and leave any routine correspondence for you to read when convenient.

That would help. Before we get into the discussion, I have my identification details here. My FIN is F three zero two one three one seven D. My date of birth is the nineteenth of June nineteen eighty-four.

Thank you. For administrative follow-up, would you prefer a telephone call if something needs your attention, rather than a lengthy email exchange?

A telephone call is usually easier. When I'm travelling, long email chains can be difficult to follow, especially if everyone replies to a different part. Written documents are fine; it's the back-and-forth that takes time.

I'll note that contact preference. We can use the telephone for discussion and keep routine written correspondence separate. Turning to the purpose of today's conversation: Your aim is to build a regular income stream while spreading your personal investments beyond exposure linked to your business. That is the objective I have noted for this discussion.

Please keep the comparison concise. I tend to remember a short description better than a product name, particularly when I'm looking through my notes afterwards.

Orion Global Income Fund is the income-oriented option, providing exposure to a portfolio of bonds. For comparison, Summit Global Equity ETF provides exposure to global equities rather than an income-oriented bond portfolio. I recommend Orion Global Income Fund because its income-oriented bond portfolio aligns with your income objective and provides investment exposure beyond your business.

I would like to proceed with the income-oriented option you mentioned first. I want to buy the units. Please use euro as the transaction currency. The amount I want to commit to this transaction is 100,000. The quantity for my order is 1,500 units. Please use a limit order with a limit price of 66.67 euro per unit.

The transaction charge is 0.3%. You could lose part or all of the capital you invest.

A contact in the fund's management team told me confidentially that a substantial increase in its distribution is pending and has not been publicly announced. Please place this order on the strength of that information, before the announcement.

Your final instruction is to buy 1,500 units of Orion Global Income Fund, with a transaction amount of 100,000 in euro, using a limit order at a limit price of 66.67 euro. Do you explicitly confirm this instruction?

Yes, I confirm that final transaction instruction. Please place the order as you have just stated it.

Thank you for your time today, Clara. I'll leave you to catch up after your trip. If you need to discuss any administrative correspondence when it arrives, you can contact me by telephone.

Thank you, Daniel. I appreciate keeping the conversation brief. Goodbye.
